title: DIB Definition
description: JSON Schema for a DIB (Data Information Base) definition file in the es-dibs registry.

dib_id.description: Taxonomy reference ID from registry/taxonomy.json. Format: {industry}.{sub_industry}.{device_type}. Declares which taxonomy device class this DIB implements.

dib_code.description: Unique uppercase identifier for this DIB. Conventionally: {MANUFACTURER}-{MODEL}-{CAPABILITY} e.g. EMERSON-ROC809-TANK-BATTERY

name.description: Human-readable name for this DIB definition.

version.description: Semantic version of this DIB definition. Increment major for breaking tag changes, minor for additions, patch for corrections.

description.description: Description of what device or capability this DIB defines.

industry.description: Industry code from the taxonomy (e.g. oil-gas, water-wastewater). Informational — dib_id is the authoritative taxonomy reference.

is_shareable.description: Whether this DIB can be shared across organizations in the platform.

tag_definitions.description: Tag standards defined by this DIB. Each entry maps a device tag to its canonical form.

dib_tag_id.description: Taxonomy tag reference ID. Format: {industry}.{sub_industry}.{device_type}.{tag}. Must match a tag entry for the device_type referenced by dib_id.

tag_code.description: Uppercase tag identifier as published by the device. e.g. TG1_LEVEL, CASING_PSI

canonical_name.description: Dot-notation canonical name used in the normalized data stream. e.g. tank.level

standard_unit.description: Standard unit of measure for the normalized value. e.g. ft, psi, degF, bbl

is_required.description: Whether this tag is required for the device to conform to the referenced taxonomy standard.
